theorem theorem_16_1
    (L₁ L₂ : Submodule ℤ ℂ)
    [DiscreteTopology L₁] [DiscreteTopology L₂]
    [IsZLattice ℝ L₁] [IsZLattice ℝ L₂]
    (φ : ComplexTorus L₁ → ComplexTorus L₂)
    (hφ : HasHolomorphicLift L₁ L₂ φ)
    (h0 : φ 0 = 0) :
    ∃! α : ℂ, ∃ hα : MapsLattice α L₁ L₂,
      ∀ x : ComplexTorus L₁,
        φ x = phiAlpha L₁ L₂ α hα x := by
  sorry
